entradas.text: "What do you think was his real intention?"
entradas.menu: "What do you think was his real intention?"

entradas.text: "How did Serge know, anyway?"
"He wished to intimidate the Assembly against our proposal, sir. And it seems to have worked."
"It doesn't matter now, does it?"
entradas.menu: "It doesn't matter now, does it?"

entradas.text: "As long as he's around, he will always have influence over the republic which he has built. We should have seen this coming."
Lucian, Petr and I met in my office and decided to move out onto the balcony to get some fresh air in the increasing summer heat.
"I still can't believe we lost by one vote..."
"Meanwhile..."
"Let's just move on to our next steps."
entradas.menu: "Let's just move on to our next steps."

entradas.text: "I don't know what to say... I still can't believe we didn't even achieve a simple majority."
"I will also try and test the waters with our MPs. We can't let the party slip out of our grasp."
"What do we do now? All our plans, for nothing..."
"We'll be organizing a cabinet meeting to discuss our present and future state of affairs."
They both looked uncomfortable in their suits. Petr was trying not to make eye contact and kept letting out depressing sighs.
"Let's just move on with our next steps."
entradas.menu: "Let's just move on with our next steps."

entradas.text: He wiped the sweat off his forehead with a handkerchief.
"Just try to reach out to him."
entradas.menu: "Just try to reach out to him."

entradas.text: "It was all Mrs. Tory's doing..."
"Of course, sir."
"The party has finally spoken."
"Okay..."
"Yes. The USP leadership is beginning to target us."
"No, he didn't."
entradas.menu: "No, he didn't."

entradas.text: "She changed the threshold! That bitch!"
"Of course, sir. We must plan ahead now."
"She merely used her authority as Speaker. It was a valid interpretation of the Constitution. There were more than 250 members present..."
"He saw their faces, but he didn't recognize them."
entradas.menu: "He saw their faces, but he didn't recognize them."

entradas.text: "Yeah... What the hell was that all about? Soll appearing out of nowhere..."
"Yes. The USP leadership is beginning to target us as well."
"Exactly. We must plan our next steps."
entradas.menu: "Exactly. We must plan our next steps."

entradas.text: "Not to mention Tarquin Soll himself."
"Let's not name any names now."
entradas.menu: "Let's not name any names now."

entradas.text: "You're right, sir. We must plan ahead now."
"Oh, he did? Who were they?"
"He came to the Assembly to make a statement. And it worked."
entradas.menu: "He came to the Assembly to make a statement. And it worked."

entradas.text: "What's done is done. Let's not linger in the past."
entradas.menu: "What's done is done. Let's not linger in the past."

entradas.text: "That's too bad."
"In any case, I will conduct proper investigations into this. We should know every hidden Old Guard member who is working with Soll."
"Gentlemen! Nothing is over yet. We still have a country to lead."
entradas.menu: "Gentlemen! Nothing is over yet. We still have a country to lead."

entradas.text: "That wasn't your fault."
entradas.menu: "That wasn't your fault."

entradas.text: "If we can lead it..."
"Maybe you should have. Even Serge knew about it."
entradas.menu: "Maybe you should have. Even Serge knew about it."

entradas.text: "You're right, sir. We must plan ahead now."
"We should organize a cabinet meeting to discuss the situation."
entradas.menu: "We should organize a cabinet meeting to discuss the situation."

entradas.text: "I'm sorry that we failed to gather the necessary intelligence about his arrival. Something went wrong on the security reports. I still don't know what. It was partly our fault."
"I'll do my best, sir."
"Y-Yes. We apologize."
"He said he overheard some people talking about it around the Assembly."
entradas.menu: "He said he overheard some people talking about it around the Assembly."

entradas.text: "It's all good."
entradas.menu: "It's all good."

entradas.text: "In a situation such as this, I would have expected Karl to report it to me. But it's no excuse. We should have done our own research."
"I learned it from Serge. How come MY DRIVER knows more than YOU!?"
entradas.menu: "I learned it from Serge. How come MY DRIVER knows more than YOU!?"

entradas.text: "What's done is done. Let's not linger in the past."
entradas.menu: "What's done is done. Let's not linger in the past."

entradas.text: "Yes, he did."
entradas.menu: "Yes, he did."

entradas.text: "In a situation such as this, I would have expected Karl to report it to me. But you're right, sir. We should have done our own research."
"But he has no authority anymore."
"I just still can't believe I didn't know about this beforehand."
entradas.menu: "I just still can't believe I didn't know about this beforehand."

entradas.text: "Well, the laws protect him from almost anything, and allows him to be a member of the Assembly. He can still propose bills and vote for them."
"Of course not, sir."
"That's proper authority, if you ask me. When you are the founder of this system, you don't need to be sitting in the presidential office to have power."
"I hope you are not hiding anything from me."
entradas.menu: "I hope you are not hiding anything from me."

entradas.text: "Are you saying he still has more authority than me?"
entradas.menu: "Are you saying he still has more authority than me?"

entradas.text: "Lucian's right. He already showcased his powers at the vote. We must be careful."
entradas.menu: "Lucian's right. He already showcased his powers at the vote. We must be careful."

entradas.text: "What? Me? Never!"
"The party is in disarray since we lost the vote. Soll might be working behind the scenes against us."
"He didn't see who they were, did he?"
"I want to talk to him. Do you know if he's still in Holsord?"
entradas.menu: "I want to talk to him. Do you know if he's still in Holsord?"

entradas.text: "No, sir. But he certainly has enormous influence."
"It seems some of our respected MPs already knew about this."
"We must be careful, indeed. The party is in disarray since we lost the vote."
"...Which we will. You're right, sir. We must plan ahead now."
"And with Soll making a comeback... We cannot trust anyone in the USP to keep supporting us."
"I guess not."
"He must be, sir. But he didn't even come to the Palace to pay his respects. I don't know what to expect."
"We cannot let the party turn against the administration."
"It smells fishy."
"Of course, sir. I'll make the necessary arrangements."
"I want a list of every party member who voted against the proposal."
entradas.menu: "I want a list of every party member who voted against the proposal."

entradas.text: "Good. I want each minister to give me a report."
entradas.menu: "Good. I want each minister to give me a report."

entradas.text: "The party has to learn to respect me. Tarquin Soll is not their leader anymore."
entradas.menu: "The party has to learn to respect me. Tarquin Soll is not their leader anymore."

entradas.text: "Sir, it was a secret ballot."
"I don't care. I want names."
entradas.menu: "I don't care. I want names."

entradas.text: "Goddammit."
entradas.menu: "Goddammit."

entradas.text: "Of course, sir. I'll do what I can."
"Don't worry, sir. We'll address the party soon enough, and put them in their proper place."
"Yes, sir."
"With a single vote, the ghost of the past has once again kept our nation from achieving progress."
"We didn't even achieve a simple majority... As expected, removing 'Sord' from the constitution was too much for the party."
